title.purpose: Page and entity titles (engagement, host, settings page).

heading.purpose: Section, panel and drawer headings; a finding title in the editor.

body.purpose: The default: rows, buttons, inputs, menu items, table cells.

code.purpose: Commands, IPs, hashes, identifiers, timestamps, payloads (JetBrains Mono, ligatures off).

meta.purpose: Helper text, secondary row lines, hint labels, warnings, empty-state text, field labels.

read-title.purpose: The Manual only: a note's own title.

read.purpose: The Manual only: a note's prose and lists, held to a 56ch measure.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: floating menus and popovers. Everything else is flat, with depth from hairlines and the two surfaces.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Small state changes (hover, press), with duration-fast.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour changes on hover and press.

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: The selection marker gliding to a new tab or sidebar item.

motion.name: duration-glide
motion.purpose: Tab and sidebar marker glides; drawers sliding in.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.note: Every view declares what it does under 1000px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent text and hairline on black, never a filled block. Only a section's main add or a dialog's Save.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-sm, 8px); height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--space-md, 12px); border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--bg, #000); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; transition: color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { border-color: var(--line, #1f1f1f); color: var(--faint, #8a8a8a); background: var(--bg, #000); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--accent, #c6ff00); color: var(--accent, #c6ff00); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Every other action: neutral hairline at rest, brighter on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-sm, 8px); height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--space-md, 12px); border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--bg, #000); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; transition: color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { border-color: var(--line, #1f1f1f); color: var(--faint, #8a8a8a); background: var(--bg, #000); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-ghost { border-color: var(--line-2, #2a2a2a); color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #3a3a3a); color: var(--fg, #fff); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Neutral at rest (one amber at rest per screen); warning amber on hover and keyboard focus. No red.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-sm, 8px); height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--space-md, 12px); border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--bg, #000); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; transition: color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { border-color: var(--line, #1f1f1f); color: var(--faint, #8a8a8a); background: var(--bg, #000); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-quiet-danger { border-color: var(--line-2, #2a2a2a); color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); } .ds-btn-quiet-danger:hover, .ds-btn-quiet-danger:focus-visible { border-color: var(--warn, #e0a030); color: var(--warn, #e0a030); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A 28px square Phosphor icon for a universal verb, with a tooltip and an aria-label.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); cursor: default; transition: color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); color: var(--fg, #fff); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: 22px pill on a strong hairline. Accent only for held access or confirmed facts; amber for dead, locked or errored.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 0 var(--space-sm, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #3a3a3a); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); font: 600 12px/16px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-accent { border-color: var(--accent, #c6ff00); color: var(--accent, #c6ff00); } .ds-chip-warn { border-color: var(--warn, #e0a030); color: var(--warn, #e0a030); }

components.name: Key Cap
components.description: One 20px mono key in the hint line. Never inside a bordered button.
components.css: .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; min-width: 20px; padding: 0 4px; margin-right: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #3a3a3a); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #0b0b0b); color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-hint { color: var(--muted, #a8a8a8); font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline on black, 32px. Brighter hairline on hover, accent focus ring, amber border when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--muted-2, #c4c4c4); font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #2a2a2a); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--bg, #000); color: var(--fg, #fff); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input-mono { font: 400 13px/20px var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #3a3a3a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--warn, #e0a030); }

components.name: Command Block
components.description: A filled command on the surface tone with its Copy button; tokens never break inside themselves.
components.html:
Scan all ports
nmap -p- --min-rate 5000 10.0.0.12
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-cmd-label { color: var(--muted-2, #c4c4c4); font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-cmd-box { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 28px; align-items: start; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1f1f1f); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--surface, #0b0b0b); } .ds-cmd-box code { color: var(--fg, #fff); font: 400 13px/20px var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-ligatures: none; } .ds-cmd-copy { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); } .ds-cmd-copy:hover { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); color: var(--fg, #fff); }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Icon, label and key number on a grid row. The current item is lit by one sliding marker: the raised surface and a 2px accent bar.
components.html: ▦Board1≡Log2
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--bg, #000); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); color: var(--fg-2, #e8e8e8); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-ui, 'Instrument Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: default; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--fg, #fff); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6ff00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-current { background: var(--surface-hi, #111111); color: var(--fg, #fff); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #c6ff00); } .ds-nav-key { color: var(--faint, #8a8a8a); font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); }

narrative.overview:
Raven is the owner's only tool open beside the attack VM, often in a window narrower than the screen, often against an exam clock. The owner has ADHD and autism. Every convention here serves one goal: **nothing needs parsing**. A glance finds the value, the action and the state.

These are rules, not suggestions. What ships today is not the reference: where the code and this document disagree, the code is wrong. New work follows this file, and `npm run audit:visual` plus `src/test/conventions.test.ts` enforce the mechanical parts.
keyCharacteristics: True black with hairlines; one accent that always means something
No red: destructive actions use the warning amber, neutral at rest
Six type roles (two more for the Manual), nothing under 12px
CSS grid with explicit tracks; flex only for single-line runs
Keyboard first: visible focus, hints that keep key and label together
Motion only explains a change, short and never looping

rules.name: One amber at rest
rules.body: At most one amber control at rest per screen. Destructive actions are neutral until hovered (see Components › Destructive actions).

rules.name: Accent is meaning
rules.body: If removing the accent from an element loses no information, the element shouldn't have it.

rules.name: The floor
rules.body: Nothing is below 12px. Only `text-label`, `Chip` and `Kbd` use 12px. Anything read as a sentence, a value or a warning is at least 13px.

rules.name: No arbitrary sizes
rules.body: In `src/features/**` and `src/ui/**` a font size comes only from a type role (`@include type(<role>)`, or `var(--text-<role>)`): no literal `font-size`, and no `font` shorthand.

rules.name: Warnings are never smaller than what they warn about
rules.body: Guard and warning lines are `text-meta` in `--warn`.

rules.name: Uppercase is for sections, not fields
rules.body: A form field's label is `text-meta` in sentence case ("Timebox start"), in `--muted-2`. Uppercase `text-label` is only for section headings, so a field label and a section heading never look alike.

rules.name: Data is never a label
rules.body: Column values, log kinds and service names use body, code or meta, never uppercase.

dos: **Do** lay out with CSS grid and explicit tracks, with one `minmax(0,1fr)` track per row.
**Do** use the six type roles (plus, in the Manual only, its two reading roles), at 13px or more for anything read.
**Do** use Phosphor icon buttons for universal verbs, with a tooltip and an `aria-label`.
**Do** keep row actions visible in a fixed-width action column.
**Do** align side-by-side siblings on shared rows (subgrid).
**Do** declare what every view does under 1000px.
**Do** keep each hint's key and label together, with 24px between hints.
donts: **Don't** lay out feature code with flex (`display: flex`, `flex-direction`, `flex-wrap`, growth, `space-between`).
**Don't** set a font size that isn't a type role, or anything under 12px.
**Don't** join structured values with " · ", " — " or " → ", in the UI or in titles Raven generates. They're for prose only.
**Don't** make an action a grey text link.
**Don't** use amber at rest for an action, or more than one amber control at rest per screen.
**Don't** put Delete in a persistent header.
**Don't** put a bordered `Kbd` inside a bordered button, or an "esc" cap in a dialog corner.
**Don't** use a brand logo for a tool-agnostic action.
**Don't** treat what already ships as approved.
